blocks.text: New Horizons Houses: the housing stock

items.t: A buyer searching this page for a detached house is searching the wrong stock: the named community's buildings are towers and low-rise apartments in a Frank Lloyd Wright-inspired style with wide, landscaped boulevards.

blocks.text: New Horizons Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Small-scale housing in Coquitlam can include single-detached dwellings, secondary suites, garden cottages and carriage houses, duplexes, triplexes, fourplexes and multiplexes, which the City groups as Small-Scale Residential.

blocks.text: New Horizons Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The street inside the community is itself called Windsor Gate, off Glen Drive and Pipeline Road, so the community name and the street name are the same word.
Glen Park sits beside the community, and the City is working towards the next phase of Glen Park improvements.
The towers' style is a stated design theme: Polygon describes Windsor Gate as built in a Frank Lloyd Wright-inspired style with wide, landscaped boulevards.

blocks.text: New Horizons Houses: getting around

items.t: Pinetree Way and the two SkyTrain stations lie to the west of the pocket, with Glen Drive running east–west through it and Pipeline Road on its east side.
Pipeline Road is being upgraded from Guildford Way to David Avenue, with four lanes, a pedestrian pathway and a two-way micromobility lane in the project scope.

blocks.text: New Horizons Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Treat a Windsor Gate purchase as a strata purchase: read the strata documents and the residents-only club's terms, because the community's homes are towers and low-rise apartments, not houses.
Expect Pipeline Road construction disruption: the upgrade and the Metro Vancouver water main section on Pipeline Road are both in delivery through 2026.

blocks.text: Jared's take on New Horizons

Around Nestor Street in north Coquitlam, New Horizons is a family neighbourhood with detached homes, townhomes and some condos. Many homes are within walking distance of Nestor Elementary, and Town Centre Park, Lafarge Lake and the SkyTrain are close, so you get a residential street near the Town Centre.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in New Horizons?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® counted 5 houses listed in New Horizons at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.

faq.q: Is New Horizons a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in New Horizons had a sales ratio of 40% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in New Horizons from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in New Horizons over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there detached houses in New Horizons?
faq.a: The named stock is strata: Windsor Gate is a 25-acre Polygon master-planned community of high-rise towers and low-rise apartment buildings around a residents-only club, begun in 2008, so a detached-house search in this sub-area runs into apartment and tower product rather than house streets.

faq.q: Which elementary school is in the pocket?
faq.a: École Glen Elementary School, at 3064 Glen Drive, is the addressed school anchor inside the pocket on the Ministry of Education's School District No. 43 (SD43) list; SD43 assigns catchments by address, so confirm the assigned school for a specific address in the district locator.

faq.q: What did houses in New Horizons sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, New Horizons recorded 23 house sales at a median of $1,200,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in New Horizons?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
